# Changes queued for SERAPIS v3.2 (v3.1 is published as 10.5281/zenodo.24281771; do not edit it)
- [D822] Remove the log-derivative plateau sentence in the SERAPIS-E section (retired: no string source, no unique test).
- [D823] Limitations: one clause that a loop-sized BHK factor (C ≈ 3–7e-7) can tilt the τ = i plateau but gives α_s ≈ −(1.0–1.2)e-3 and a massless vacuum, so ε stays fitted.
- [D824] Sec. X / Σm_ν line: add that the NO floor is a class prediction (NO + ΛCDM), alive by 0.0005 eV against < 0.0592 eV; cite 2610.20977's negative-mass preference.
- [D826] Limitations: the vacuum mass at i shares the fitted ε; covariant F-term and loop sources fall 10¹¹–10¹² short (D826); the only candidate is the anti-D3 log correction (P3 sector).
- [D832] Limitations: state that the plateau's anti-D3 origin (P3) has no one-loop source; the explicit anti-D3 term on T⁶/(Z₂×Z₂) is additive and rises linearly in Im τ (D829–D831). Remaining routes: warped throat or non-perturbative.
- [D830] Tadpole: with an anti-D3 present the D3 configuration is (N, N0) = (5, 2), N_eff = 3 (or 4 if the anti-D3 sits over the origin, D831), not D696's (5, 1). Im S·Im ρ stays natural (≈ 560–975).
- [D836] Limitations: if the plateau's anti-D3 is present, its one-loop interaction requires large small tori (v₄ ≳ 2e4·g_s) for the frozen band to hold; at natural size it shifts n_s by ≈ +0.02 (D835). It also leaves no source for the τ = i vacuum mass (D834).
